name: Barnimages
summary: Free high-resolution stock photo library by two independent photographers, no attribution required.
description: A curated collection of free photographs shot by two Hamburg photographers since 2015, free for personal and commercial use without attribution. Photos are hand-picked rather than open-upload, and the site also publishes blog guides on free mockups, newsletter images and stock photo licenses.
